error_internal.message: Something went wrong in Kotiko. Check the server log.

error_internal_ref.message: Something went wrong in Kotiko. Check the server log for ref {ref}.
error_internal_ref.description: 500: a bug. REF finds the error in the server log.

error_request_too_large.description: 413: the body is over the limit.

error_invalid_request.message: The server couldn't read that request; details.field names the part to fix.
error_invalid_request.description: 400: a parameter or body field is missing or wrong.

error_invalid_request_content_type.message: Send the body as JSON, with the header Content-Type: application/json.
error_invalid_request_content_type.description: 415: the body was sent with another content type.

error_invalid_request_words.description: 400: the batch add's word list is missing or too long. MAX is the limit.

error_invalid_request_action.description: 400: the pronunciation job's control without an action.

error_invalid_word.message: That change isn't a valid word.
error_invalid_word.description: 400: an edit doesn't make a valid word; details say which field.

error_input_too_long.message: That's a lot of text for one word.
error_input_too_long.description: 400: the add text is over 200 characters.

error_server_key_rejected.message: This Kotiko server didn't accept the access key. Paste it again in Connection.

error_word_gone_scrubbed.message: That word was removed too long ago to restore.

error_word_conflict_duplicate.message: Another word already has that key.
error_word_conflict_duplicate.description: 409: another word has the same language, text and meaning.

error_server_address_invalid.message: This Kotiko server doesn't answer to that address.
error_server_address_invalid.description: 421: the request reached the server by an address it doesn't answer to.

error_server_address_invalid_host_not_al.message: This Kotiko server doesn't answer to {host}. Add it to ALLOWED_HOSTS in .env.
error_server_address_invalid_host_not_al.description: 421: the Host header names a host the server doesn't answer to. HOST is that name.

error_server_address_invalid_no_host.message: This Kotiko server only answers requests without a Host header from this computer.
error_server_address_invalid_no_host.description: 421: a request without a Host header came from another computer.

error_quota_exhausted.message: You've used today's free lookups. Add words yourself, or try again after {time} UTC.
error_quota_exhausted.description: 429: today's free lookups are used up. TIME is HH:MM in UTC.

error_quota_exhausted_today.message: You've used today's free lookups. Add words yourself, or try again tomorrow.
error_quota_exhausted_today.description: 429: today's free lookups are used up; the reset time isn't known.

error_quota_exhausted_payment_required.message: {provider} needs credit on your account before it will look up words, even free ones. Add credit there, or add words yourself.
error_quota_exhausted_payment_required.description: 429: the provider asks for payment (402). PROVIDER is its name.

error_rate_limited.message: Word lookup is busy. Try again in a minute.
error_rate_limited.description: 429: the provider asked to slow down.

error_rate_limited_auth_failures.message: Too many wrong access keys came from this address. Wait a minute, then check the key in Connection.
error_rate_limited_auth_failures.description: 429: 10 wrong tokens from this address within a minute; Retry-After says when to try again.

error_rate_limited_too_many_proofs.message: Too many requests from this address. Try again in a minute.
error_rate_limited_too_many_proofs.description: 429: too many POST /api/v1/proof requests from this address within a minute.

error_model_unavailable.message: Word lookup isn't answering right now. Try again in a little while.

error_lookup_timeout.message: That lookup took too long. Try again.
error_lookup_timeout.description: 503: no answer within the add's deadline.

error_bad_lookup_result.message: The lookup came back garbled. Try again, or add the word yourself.
error_bad_lookup_result.description: 502: the model's answer couldn't be used.

error_key_rejected.message: {provider} didn't accept the server's key (LLM_API_KEY). Check it, then restart the server.
error_key_rejected.description: 502: the provider refused the server's key. PROVIDER is its name.

error_lookup_not_set_up.message: Word lookup isn't set up: add LLM_API_KEY to the server's .env and restart it.

error_lookup_failed.description: A lookup failed with a code that has no message of its own.

provider_unknown.description: Stands in for PROVIDER when the provider isn't known.

bot_help.message:
Kotiko: send me a word and it starts appearing on your web pages in place of the word you'd normally read there.

Send me a word any way you like, typed or as a voice note:

• "what's da" or "what does shukran mean"
• "how do you say dog in japanese"
• "add sobaka" (saves it straight away)

Any language works, and a new one starts the moment you add its first word. If I pick the wrong language, say which: "da in serbian".

Tap Add on a card and that word starts appearing on pages in the languages you read. Choose which languages show up in the extension's popup.

/list  your newest words
/list arabic  newest words in one language
/languages  how many words you know in each
/remove <word>  stop replacing a word
/bases  the languages meanings are in
/language  the language I write in
bot_help.description: Telegram bot: the reply to /help and /start. The quoted examples are things to send the bot; translate them into requests in your language. Keep the /commands as they are.

bot_setup_your_id.message:
Almost set up. Your Telegram ID is {id}.

Put ALLOWED_TELEGRAM_IDS={id} in .env and restart the server.
bot_setup_your_id.description: Telegram bot: the reply to anyone while ALLOWED_TELEGRAM_IDS is empty. ID is their numeric Telegram user id.

bot_command_list.description: Telegram bot: the command menu's description of /list.

bot_command_languages.message: how many words you know in each language
bot_command_languages.description: Telegram bot: the command menu's description of /languages.

bot_command_remove.description: Telegram bot: the command menu's description of /remove.

bot_command_bases.description: Telegram bot: the command menu's description of /bases.

bot_command_language.description: Telegram bot: the command menu's description of /language.

bot_command_help.description: Telegram bot: the command menu's description of /help.

bot_list_header.description: Telegram bot: above /list. COUNT is how many words the learner has.

bot_list_line.description: Telegram bot: one line of /list. WORD is the saved word, GLOSS its meaning, LANGUAGE the word's language name.

bot_list_none.message: No words yet. Send me one.
bot_list_none.description: Telegram bot: /list when there are no words.

bot_list_none_in.message: No words in "{term}" yet. /languages shows what you have.
bot_list_none_in.description: Telegram bot: /list <language> when no word is in that language. TERM is what the learner typed.

bot_languages_line.description: Telegram bot: one line of /languages. LANGUAGE is a language name, COUNT how many words are in it.

bot_languages_none.message: No words yet. Send me one in any language.
bot_languages_none.description: Telegram bot: /languages when there are no words.

bot_remove_none.description: Telegram bot: /remove when nothing matches. TERM is what the learner typed.

bot_removed.message: Removed {words}. They no longer appear on your pages.
bot_removed.description: Telegram bot: after /remove. WORDS lists the removed words with their meanings.

bot_voice_off.message: Voice notes aren't switched on yet (TRANSCRIBE_URL is empty). Type it, or use your keyboard's mic button to dictate a text message.
bot_voice_off.description: Telegram bot: a voice note when the server has no speech-to-text service.

bot_voice_failed.message: I couldn't make out that voice note. Try again, or type it.
bot_voice_failed.description: Telegram bot: a voice note the speech-to-text service couldn't transcribe. The cause is in the server log.

bot_voice_heard.description: Telegram bot: echoes what the speech-to-text service heard. TEXT is the transcript.

bot_no_word.message: I couldn't find a word in that. Try "what's da" or "add sobaka".
bot_no_word.description: Telegram bot: a message the model found no word in. The quoted examples are things to send the bot.

bot_rejected_intro.description: Telegram bot: above one line per word the checks refused.

bot_rejected_line.description: Telegram bot: one refused word. WORD is the word, REASON one of the bot_rejected_* reasons.

bot_rejected_script_mismatch.message: that isn't written in the language's own script
bot_rejected_script_mismatch.description: Telegram bot: reason a word was refused (slice 25 code script_mismatch), e.g. Russian written in Latin letters.

bot_rejected_same_as_gloss.message: that's already a word in a language you read
bot_rejected_same_as_gloss.description: Telegram bot: reason a word was refused (same_as_gloss, target_is_base).

bot_rejected_invalid_lang.message: I couldn't tell which language that is
bot_rejected_invalid_lang.description: Telegram bot: reason a word was refused (invalid_lang).

bot_rejected_sign_language_unsupported.message: sign languages can't be swapped into text
bot_rejected_sign_language_unsupported.description: Telegram bot: reason a word was refused (sign_language_unsupported).

bot_rejected_too_many_words.description: Telegram bot: reason a word was refused (too_many_words). MAX is the limit.

bot_rejected_other.message: the answer didn't pass Kotiko's checks
bot_rejected_other.description: Telegram bot: reason a word was refused, for any other check.

bot_card_added.message: ✅ Added. It shows up on pages now.
bot_card_added.description: Telegram bot: under a word card once the word is saved.

bot_card_already.description: Telegram bot: under a word card for a word the learner already has.

bot_card_skipped.description: Telegram bot: under a word card after Skip.

bot_card_removed.description: Telegram bot: under a word card after Remove or Undo.

bot_card_careful.description: Telegram bot: word card, how the word sounds said slowly and clearly, e.g. "Slowly: pa-ZHA-lu-sta". The capitals mark the stressed syllable. Same wording as the extension's popover_careful.

bot_pron_ai.description: Telegram bot: word card, after the romanization: the pronunciation was written by the AI model. Same wording as the extension's popover_pron_ai.

bot_pron_checked.description: Telegram bot: word card, the pronunciation comes from a dictionary. SOURCE is its name, e.g. Wiktionary. Same wording as the extension's popover_pron_checked.

bot_button_add.description: Telegram bot: button on a word card that saves the word.

bot_button_skip.description: Telegram bot: button on a word card that drops the lookup.

bot_button_remove.description: Telegram bot: button on a word card that removes a saved word.

bot_button_undo.description: Telegram bot: button on a word card that removes the word just added.

bot_toast_added.description: Telegram bot: short pop-up after tapping Add.

bot_toast_removed.description: Telegram bot: short pop-up after tapping Remove or Undo.

bot_toast_gone.description: Telegram bot: short pop-up after tapping a button on a card whose word no longer exists.

bot_meanings_in.description: Telegram bot: shown once on the first card when the server doesn't know the learner's languages yet and guessed them. LANGUAGES lists them, each in its own language (español, English).

bot_untranslated.description: Telegram bot: shown once when the learner's language has no translation and the bot writes in this one. LANGUAGE is the learner's language, in itself (español).

bot_bases_show.message: Meanings are in {languages}. To change them, send /bases and up to {max} language codes, the one you read most first: /bases es en
bot_bases_show.description: Telegram bot: /bases without languages. LANGUAGES lists the current ones, MAX the limit.

bot_bases_set.description: Telegram bot: after /bases. LANGUAGES lists them, each in its own language.

bot_bases_invalid.message: I couldn't read those as languages. Send up to {max} language codes, the one you read most first: /bases es en
bot_bases_invalid.description: Telegram bot: /bases with something that isn't a list of languages. MAX is the limit.

bot_language_show.message: I write in {language}. To change it, send /language and a language code, like /language es. /language auto follows your Telegram app.
bot_language_show.description: Telegram bot: /language without a code. LANGUAGE is the bot's current language, in itself.

bot_language_set.message: I'll write in {language} from now on.
bot_language_set.description: Telegram bot: after /language <code>. LANGUAGE is the chosen language, in itself.

bot_language_auto.message: I'll follow your Telegram app's language.

bot_language_invalid.message: I don't know that language code. Try /language es, or /language auto.
bot_language_invalid.description: Telegram bot: /language with something that isn't a language code.

error_invalid_request_base_langs.message: Send {"base_langs": [...]} with 1 to {max} language tags, the primary first.
error_invalid_request_base_langs.description: 400: base_langs is missing, empty, too long or has something that isn't a language tag. MAX is the limit.

error_invalid_request_ui_lang.message: Send "ui_lang" as a language tag, "auto" or null.
error_invalid_request_ui_lang.description: 400: PUT /api/v1/profile with a ui_lang that isn't a language tag.
